title: They bill you!
body: Owerwhelming app with tons of notifications and the try everything to try to get paid. There is not much flexibility and the instantly insit you “make a habit” of drinking water. As a person who has some habits already this sucks. Way too much going on and little options to tailor to your own habit tracking. Avoid!

title: Been great
body:
Only one downside is that ever since I attempted to do two journeys at once they just get stuck on the same day and don't work like they used to. It may be fixed by now but I haven't been actively pursuing the journeys for a few weeks now so I don't know.
Otherwise incredibly helpful app that really makes life easier, the little motivational pictures are really nice too. I use this every day and it's been a complete life changer.
